strategies.generator: Wait for something concrete to engage before committing energy
strategies.manifesting_generator: Wait for a clear response, then communicate before moving quickly
strategies.manifestor: Inform the people affected before initiating independent action
strategies.projector: Wait for recognition and a fitting invitation before offering sustained guidance
strategies.reflector: Allow a full lunar cycle and varied contexts before major commitments

activations.label: {planet} in the {layer} layer activates Gate {gate}, line {line}.

digestion.label: Digestion and sensory intake
digestion.transference: Under pressure, attention may drift toward a transferred intake pattern associated with color {color}; noticing the shift matters more than enforcing a rule.

environment.label: Supportive environment
environment.transference: When context feels strained, color {color} may describe the environment being pursued rather than the one that supports ease and orientation.

motivation.label: Motivational perspective
motivation.transference: Color {color} can mark a transferred motive that becomes louder under pressure; curiosity helps distinguish it from a steadier inner orientation.

perspective.label: View and attention
perspective.transference: A color {color} transfer can narrow what receives attention. Use it as a prompt to widen perspective, not as a judgment about perception.

center_themes.head: The Head organizes inspiration and questions. When open, mental pressure can be sampled from the environment without requiring every question to be answered.
center_themes.ajna: The Ajna describes recurring ways of organizing concepts. Definition can bring consistency; openness can support intellectual range when certainty is not forced.
center_themes.throat: The Throat concerns expression and visible action. Its pattern becomes clearer through timing, audience, and the channels that connect expression to the rest of the design.
center_themes.g: The G center frames identity, direction, and love. Whether defined or open, place and relationship context can reveal how direction feels coherent.
center_themes.ego: The Ego concerns will, value, and promises. Sustainable commitments come from honest capacity rather than attempts to prove worth.
center_themes.solar_plexus: The Solar Plexus concerns emotional movement and relational sensitivity. Space for changing feeling states can support more considered choices.
center_themes.spleen: The Spleen describes immediate instinct, pattern recognition, and present-time awareness. Its signals are subtle and are best observed without turning them into fear-based rules.
center_themes.sacral: The Sacral concerns responsive vitality and sustainable engagement. Energy often becomes easier to read in relation to a concrete option rather than an abstract obligation.
center_themes.root: The Root organizes pressure and momentum. Distinguishing useful activation from urgency can protect pacing and completion.

themes.type: The {type} pattern describes how energy and opportunity are most naturally encountered; it is an experiment in pacing, not a fixed identity.
themes.authority: {authority} authority invites decisions to be grounded in a repeatable inner process rather than immediate social or mental pressure.
themes.profile: Profile {personalityLine}/{designLine} combines a conscious social role with a less deliberate way others may experience the person.
themes.definition: {definition} describes how consistently defined centers exchange information and where other people or environments may add temporary bridges.

prominence.repeated_gate: Gate {gate} appears {count} times, giving its theme repeated emphasis across planetary and conscious/unconscious layers.
prominence.line: Line {line} occurs {count} times, making its learning style a recurring lens for how themes are approached.
prominence.circuit: The {circuit} circuit appears in {count} defined channel(s), concentrating attention around its characteristic way of relating and contributing.

decision_making.title: Decision-making mechanics
decision_making.overview: As a {type} with {authority} authority, clarity is supported by coordinating energetic timing with the body's repeatable decision process.

energy_and_expression.title: Energy and expression
energy_and_expression.overview: {definedCenters} defined center(s) and {channels} channel(s) describe where energy and expression tend to repeat with greater consistency.

identity_and_role.title: Identity and social role
identity_and_role.overview: Lines {personalityLine}/{designLine} combine an observable role with a deeper learning pattern, shaping how participation and recognition develop over time.

conditioning_and_openness.title: Openness and contextual learning
conditioning_and_openness.overview: {openCenters} open center(s) highlight areas where sensitivity to people and setting can become discernment when experience is observed without self-judgment.

relationships_and_circuitry.title: Relationships and circuitry
relationships_and_circuitry.overview: {channels} defined channel(s) show recurring pathways of connection; relationships can amplify, bridge, or contrast these patterns without determining their outcome.

life_theme.title: Life-theme orientation
life_theme.overview: Incarnation-cross availability is {available}. When present, its four Sun/Earth gates offer a broad thematic frame rather than a prescribed purpose.

variables_and_transference.title: Variables and transference
variables_and_transference.overview: {variables} variable(s) add a time-sensitive lens on intake, environment, motivation, and view. They are most useful as gentle experiments after basic mechanics.

gates_and_lines.title: Gates, lines, and activations
gates_and_lines.overview: {gates} active gate(s) across {activations} activation(s) describe the detailed vocabulary through which broader center and channel themes become specific.

integration.title: Integration
integration.overview: {definition} provides the structural backdrop for integrating decision-making, relationships, openness, and recurring themes into one lived experiment.

strengths.decision_making: A reliable strength is the ability to let {type} timing and {authority} authority cooperate before commitment.
strengths.energy_and_expression: Defined energy can provide continuity without requiring constant output; consistency becomes a resource when pacing remains responsive.
strengths.identity_and_role: The {personalityLine}/{designLine} profile can translate lived experience into a recognizable and increasingly authentic social contribution.
strengths.conditioning_and_openness: Openness can become nuanced social intelligence, revealing distinctions that a consistently defined experience may overlook.
strengths.relationships_and_circuitry: Defined circuitry offers dependable ways of connecting, organizing exchange, and recognizing which relationships support mutual movement.
strengths.life_theme: When available, the cross can gather recurring interests into a coherent narrative while leaving room for choice and development.
strengths.variables_and_transference: Variable awareness can sharpen sensitivity to supportive conditions without turning preference into rigid self-management.
strengths.gates_and_lines: Repeated gates and lines offer a rich vocabulary for observing how the same theme matures across different situations.
strengths.integration: The {definition} pattern can support recognition of what is internally consistent and what benefits from dialogue or environmental input.

challenges.decision_making: Immediate pressure may compete with {authority} authority; urgency can be noticed without being treated as proof of clarity.
challenges.energy_and_expression: Consistent energy may be overused or assumed to be endlessly available, especially when external expectations reward constant performance.
challenges.identity_and_role: Profile projections can invite roles that do not fit; recognition becomes clearer when expectations are named rather than silently carried.
challenges.conditioning_and_openness: Open-center sensitivity may be mistaken for a personal deficiency or obligation, obscuring what actually belongs to the surrounding context.
challenges.relationships_and_circuitry: Chemistry and completion can feel compelling, yet neither guarantees compatibility, consent, or shared priorities.
challenges.life_theme: A thematic label can become restrictive when treated as a destiny instead of a reflective frame for recurring experience.
challenges.variables_and_transference: Precision language may encourage overcontrol when birth time is uncertain or when subtle preferences are treated as universal rules.
challenges.gates_and_lines: Detailed activation language can fragment the reading unless each gate and line is returned to its center, channel, and lived context.
challenges.integration: The {definition} pattern may be overidentified with, reducing openness to growth, contradiction, and situational complexity.

practices.decision_making: For a meaningful choice, record the first impulse, then revisit it through the {type} strategy and {authority} process before acting.
practices.energy_and_expression: Notice which activities leave energy more coherent afterward and which create depletion despite appearing productive.
practices.identity_and_role: Compare roles that arrive through genuine recognition with roles accepted mainly to satisfy projection or expectation.
practices.conditioning_and_openness: After intense contact, spend time in a neutral setting and observe which pressures, moods, or certainties naturally soften.
practices.relationships_and_circuitry: Discuss pacing, boundaries, and contribution directly instead of inferring relational meaning from channel chemistry alone.
practices.life_theme: Journal recurring themes across several months and keep only the language that expands agency and accurate self-recognition.
practices.variables_and_transference: Change one environmental or intake condition at a time, then observe ease, attention, and sustainability without forcing a preferred result.
practices.gates_and_lines: Choose one repeated gate or line and track how its constructive and strained expressions differ across real situations.
practices.integration: Review the reading as a whole and identify one experiment that supports choice, relationship clarity, and sustainable participation.

lunar_phase.new_moon: The New Moon phase joins intention and feeling closely, favoring subjective beginnings and learning through direct engagement.
lunar_phase.waxing_crescent: The Waxing Crescent phase develops commitment through early friction, asking emerging intentions to find practical support.
lunar_phase.first_quarter: The First Quarter phase emphasizes action, adjustment, and the courage to shape circumstances rather than wait for certainty.
lunar_phase.waxing_gibbous: The Waxing Gibbous phase refines what has begun, combining aspiration with a strong impulse to improve and prepare.
lunar_phase.full_moon: The Full Moon phase heightens awareness through contrast, relationship, and the need to see an experience from more than one side.
lunar_phase.waning_gibbous: The Waning Gibbous phase favors interpretation and sharing, turning completed experience into perspective that can benefit others.
lunar_phase.last_quarter: The Last Quarter phase questions inherited assumptions and supports deliberate revision of habits, loyalties, and direction.
lunar_phase.waning_crescent: The Waning Crescent phase favors release, integration, and quiet preparation before another cycle of initiative begins.
